name: Ten-Gate Criteria Chain
purpose: 在宣称一个学习/评测结论成立之前，逐条自检；缺任何一条都必须标为 insufficient evidence

gates.name: effective_rank_gate
gates.fail_meaning: 目标本身不可学，不要开始训练

gates.name: main_gate_v1c
gates.fail_meaning: 分数可能只是抖动，不是优势

gates.name: power_precheck
gates.fail_meaning: 永远差一点点，不要用'分不开'当结论

gates.name: control_of_control
gates.fail_meaning: 你的对照本身可能坏了，通过它不代表任何事

gates.name: three_exactly
gates.fail_meaning: 出现了退化情形，指标无意义

gates.name: ci_not_straddling
gates.fail_meaning: 区间里住着两个相反的世界，此时拍板就是赌

gates.name: recomputation_path
gates.fail_meaning: 撤回变成新悬案；声明不等于更正

gates.name: publish_gate
layers: if CI clean: point estimate over line is enough
if CI straddles: require (action reversible and near-zero rollback cost) OR (both sides of the line above minimum usable level)
gates.fail_meaning: 不该发的发了，会不可逆地污染公开记录

gates.name: pre_flight_three
questions: is the signal capturable without learning? (effective rank<5 stop; shuffle-retrain must separate)
how much does the trivial baseline leave? (learning must beat it by >=10%)
can samples separate? (required test samples > 10x acceptable window -> stop)
gates.fail_meaning: 钱和三个月会花在一个题本身不值钱的地方
